Overview.Purpose: Defines the top-level genotype dataclass that combines active genes with archived genetic material and mutation behavior.
Main_Use_Cases: Store the root node and active NodeGene mapping
Carry archived nodes and connections used by topology mutations
Expose mutation behavior through GenotypeMutationMixin

Genotype.Purpose: Stores a genotype graph recipe plus archived genetic material for mutation reuse.

nodes.Description: Active node genes keyed by node name.

control_mode.Description: Global controller family for the genotype: neural or sine.

archived_connections.Description: Inactive named connection genes retained as mutation templates.

archived_nodes.Description: Inactive named node genes retained as mutation templates.

Overview.Purpose: Genotype mutation, split by subsystem. GenotypeMutationMixin combines the mixins in evc3d.mutation.selection (choose what to mutate), .values (mutate one field value), .neural (neural controller weights), .topology (add/remove/relink connections and nodes), and .gene_pool (naming, archiving, pruning), with shared constants in .settings. Genotype inherits it.
Main_Use_Cases: Mutate numeric, boolean, and tuple-valued genotype fields
Add, remove, replace, and retarget genotype connections
Create new mutated node genes and archive disconnected genetic material

Constructor.Signature: FlyingAwayEvaluationConfig(settle_seconds: float = 0.0, max_creature_height: float = 0.0, min_center_height_fraction: float = 0.0, initial_floor_contact_policy: str = no_contact, episode_seconds: float = 10.0, max_body_count: int = 500, self_collision: bool = False, disallow_collision: bool = False, target_direction: Sequence[float] = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0), body_count_weight: float = 0.001, volume_weight: float = 0.01, volume_penalty_cutoff: float = 0.1, min_body_volume: float = 1e-06, min_total_volume: float = 0.0001, max_volume: float = 1.0, build_failure_fitness: float = -1000.0, max_abs_state_value: float = 1000000.0, max_abs_velocity: float = 1000.0, max_abs_acceleration: float = 100000.0, energy_weight: float = 1e-07, angular_speed_weight: float = 0.01, height_loss_weight: float = 0.5, ground_touch_weight: float = 0.0, no_ground_touch_bonus: float = 10, fitness_gain_fraction: float = 0.5, origin_speed_weight: float = 0.1) -> None

settle_seconds.Description: Seconds to settle before the episode starts.

max_creature_height.Description: Start rule: maximum creature height in meters (0 disables).

min_center_height_fraction.Description: Start rule: minimum center height as a fraction of creature height.

initial_floor_contact_policy.Description: Start rule: allow, no_penetration (reject floor penetration), or no_contact (reject any floor contact).

episode_seconds.Description: Scored episode length in simulated seconds.

disallow_collision.Description: Disqualify creatures whose non-parent parts collide.

volume_weight.Description: Fitness penalty per cubic meter above volume_penalty_cutoff.

volume_penalty_cutoff.Description: Volume allowed without penalty, in cubic meters.

min_body_volume.Description: Minimum volume per body part, in cubic meters.

min_total_volume.Description: Minimum total volume, in cubic meters.

max_volume.Description: Maximum total volume, in cubic meters.

build_failure_fitness.Description: Fitness assigned to failed or disqualified creatures.

energy_weight.Description: Fitness penalty per unit control energy.

angular_speed_weight.Description: Fitness penalty per unit mean angular speed.

height_loss_weight.Description: Fitness penalty per meter of center-of-mass height loss.

ground_touch_weight.Description: Penalty scale for touching the ground early.

no_ground_touch_bonus.Description: Bonus when the creature never touches the ground.

fitness_gain_fraction.Description: Blend between controlled-minus-passive fitness gain (1) and controlled fitness (0).

origin_speed_weight.Description: Fitness weight on average speed away from the start.
